item.text: {"case_id":"SPR00141","decision":"candidate","candidate_ranking":["C02","C05","C04"],"selected_candidate_label":"C02","confidence":0.96,"relationship_type":"both","rationale":"C02 plausibly supplied a concrete drafting template. It uses the same compact sequence: identify covered income-tax returns; declare them open to inspection by a named federal agency for administering that agency's statutory powers; require inspection in accordance and upon compliance with Treasury rules in a Treasury decision approved the same date; and make the order effective upon Federal Register filing. The child adapts this machinery from corporation returns and the Federal Trade Commission to individual returns and the Department of Health, Education, and Welfare. C05 has a similarly close agency-inspection structure, while C04 closely matches the Treasury-compliance language, including reference to two Treasury decisions, but concerns congressional inspection.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"any individual income tax return ... shall be open to inspection by the Department of Health, Education, and Welfare as may be needed in its administration of the provisions of Title II of the Social Security Act","parent_excerpt":"corporation income tax returns ... shall be open to inspection by the Federal Trade Commission as an aid in executing the powers conferred upon such Commission by the Federal Trade Commission Act","explanation":"Both use the same operative authorization structure, substituting the class of returns, inspecting agency, and governing statute."},{"child_excerpt":"The inspection ... shall be in accordance and upon compliance with the rules and regulations prescribed by the Secretary of the Treasury in the two Treasury decisions ... approved by me this date.","parent_excerpt":"such inspection to be in accordance and upon compliance with the rules and regulations prescribed by the Secretary of the Treasury in the Treasury decision ... approved by me this date.","explanation":"This is distinctive, substantially identical administrative machinery governing how the authorized inspection occurs."},{"child_excerpt":"This order shall become effective upon its filing for publication in the FEDERAL REGISTER.","parent_excerpt":"This Executive order shall be effective upon its filing for publication in the FEDERAL REGISTER.","explanation":"The effective-date clause completes the same provision sequence, though it is routine standing alone."}]}
